executable_convention.hull_entry: min C such that f is in conv of all routes with overload<=C
executable_convention.negative_certificate: one cost-good route with overload<k17 excludes an endpoint from improving the record
executable_convention.orders: left=(0,...,k-1), right=permutation, rows are both prefix chains with duplicate full row removed
executable_convention.overload: maximum of every shared and private residual
executable_convention.rank_cost_boundary: sum f=rank-1+eta, unit rank reward; |z|=rank is cost-good

scope: Every scheduled finite seed/continuation endpoint is rounded to denominator 1e9 and defeated by an explicitly evaluated cost-good exact-rank route below the k=17 record. This exhausts the recorded campaigns, not all clone multiplicities, all interleavings, or the continuous optimum of a fixed topology.
